_meta.note: One entry per NASA PSI combustion investigation: what the PSI file listing names, by PSI category and by kind of file. Counts and sizes are computed by the team from the listings; they are not NASA statements about the data.
_meta.listings_source: POST https://psi.nasa.gov/geode-py/ws/files/v2 (public file listing of https://psi.nasa.gov/), saved unchanged in data/psi/file_listings/
_meta.classification_rule: Kinds are decided from file names and PSI categories only, by the ordered rules of pipeline/spec/raw_kinds.json. No file was opened or downloaded. A kind says what the name says, not what the file holds; a listing says nothing about the content or the quality of a file.
_meta.counting_rule: A file is one record of the listing. PSI listings repeat some rows (same file id in the same folder); a repeated row is counted once ('listing_rows' minus 'repeated_rows' = 'files'; 'listing_rows_bytes' is the sum over all rows, repeats included, for comparison). Where PSI lists several records under one storage key (other versions of a name) each record is counted; 'records_beyond_one_per_key' says how many.
_meta.units: 'bytes' are integers as PSI reports them (bytes_size). In 'sentence' sizes use decimal units with one decimal: 1 MB = 10^6 bytes, 1 GB = 10^9 bytes; GB from 10^9 bytes, MB below.

fields.listing: 'ok', or 'not available: <reason>' when the listing call failed; such an entry has no counts.
fields.by_category: The PSI category names exactly as the listing gives them, each with files, bytes and the kinds inside it.
fields.by_kind: Files and bytes per kind over the whole listing, the extensions inside the kind, and the name of the largest file as 'example'. For archives, 'archive_content' counts what the names state.
fields.test_id_in_file_names: Name patterns carried by the files of 'searched_categories', with the number of names that match and three example names. Only what the names show; no name is mapped to a row of an experimental table. Empty when no pattern of the spec is carried.
fields.sentence: One fixed sentence (template in the spec file) filled only with numbers of the same entry.

_meta.written_by: pipeline/raw_inventory.py from data/psi/file_listings/, data/psi/manifest.json and pipeline/spec/raw_kinds.json
